body: Lore-first into TYLER #120-123, then sprite+stats+real neutral-special moves in BRAWLPIT -- discovered BTN_SPECIAL already had a working per-character-branchable framework (up-B/side-special/neutral-special), just needed new branches. Medusa=directional stun, Raccoon=pure-mobility dash, Second Tree=real AOE knockback, Uncrowned=defensive shield buff. Live-verified via headless test harness (13/13 checks), caught+fixed a real SHIELD_MAX scale bug along the way. Commit BRAWLPIT 8bb2119.
title: 4 new fighters (Medusa/Raccoon/Second Tree/Uncrowned) with real unique specials
